children: On October 14, 2026, the company received notice from Nasdaq that it failed to meet the $1.00 minimum bid price under Listing Rule 5550(a)(2) for 30 consecutive business days ended October 13, 2026. The company has 180 days, until April 12, 2027, to regain compliance, with a potential additional 180-day period. The notice has no immediate effect on its Nasdaq listing.
